title: Wellness Membership Freeze Allowances and Freeze Fees
content:
Every tier of the Wellness Membership may be frozen; the tiers differ in the number of freezes per membership year, the longest freeze and the freeze fee.

| Tier | Freeze available | Shortest freeze | Longest freeze | Freezes per membership year | Fee per month, or part of a month, of a non-medical freeze | Fee waived for a freeze supported by a medical note | Frozen months added to the end of the commitment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | 1 | 10.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Aquatic Access Membership | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | 1 | 10.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | 1 | 10.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Wellness Plus Membership | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | 2 | 10.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Performance Membership | Yes | 30 calendar days | 90 calendar days | 2 | 15.00 | Yes | Yes |
| Performance Plus Membership | Yes | 30 calendar days | 120 calendar days | 2 | 15.00 | Yes | Yes |

## How the columns read

- **Membership year** is counted from the start date of the membership, not from January 1.
- **Freeze fee** is charged per month, or part of a month, of a non-medical (personal) freeze, in US dollars.
- **Medical note**: on every tier the freeze fee is waived for a freeze supported by a medical note.
- **Added to the end of the commitment**: on every tier, frozen months are added to the end of the commitment.

## Where the tiers differ

- Two freezes per membership year on the Wellness Plus Membership, the Performance Membership and the Performance Plus Membership; one on the other three tiers.
- A fee of 15.00 per month, or part of a month, on the Performance Membership and the Performance Plus Membership; 10.00 on the other four tiers.
- A longest freeze of 120 calendar days on the Performance Plus Membership; 90 calendar days on the other five tiers. The shortest freeze is 30 calendar days on every tier.
